newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter offers gold with guaranteed buyback.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter offers gold with guaranteed buyback.

text.p: For the first time in the U.S., investors can now buy a gold product with a guaranteed repurchase price - "UBS kinebar 2001" - distributed by Dean Witter Reynolds.

"Union Bank of Switzerland, through Dean Witter, will either repurchase the gold bars at a guaranteed minimum price of $360 per troy ounce until Dec 18, 2001, or the current market price of gold, whichever is greater," Dean Witter vice president Mark Hawley said.
The gold bars are being offered in sizes of 100 grams (3.215 troy ounces) and one kilogram (32.15 troy ounces).
Investors may either take delivery of the gold or store their bars at a designated Dean Witter depositary.

Additionally, provided the bars are not damaged, Union Bank of Switzerland will not require the UBS kinebar 2001 be assayed prior to repurchase, saving investors the traditional assay cost often incurred with precious metal products.

To enhance protection against counterfeiting, the 99.9 percent pure gold bars are protected with patented "Kinegram" security technology, which embosses a two dimensional computer-generated image directly onto the surface of the bar, Hawley said.

"UBS is making the market in this product and will quote a bid/offer price, which includes a small premium for the put option, which may be around 4.0 pct currently, but could get down to around 2.0 pct if the gold price were to rise back above $400," Hawley said.
